correctness.rationale: PASS: A connected cactus decomposes into edge-disjoint simple-cycle blocks C_i of lengths ell_i, with oriented sums z_i forming an integral basis of H1 of rank b1>=2. Define F-linear extension s on oriented edges e of C_i by signed z_i/ell_i and s(bridges)=0. Then s(z_i)=z_i, and max unit-edge l1 norm =max_i 1/ell_i=1/g(X). For any chain extension s and any cointegral basis B, nonzero shortest z_i has integral nonzero B-coordinates, so 1<=||z_i||_1^B=||sum_{e in Ci}±s(e)||_1<=g(X)||s||^B. Taking all infima yields exactly reciprocal girth. Non-tree-edge relative generators give geometric G1(X)=1. No 2-cells or overlapping-cycle assumptions are silently used.
